subject: Runway proposal: milestone-gated extension with flexible credits — Edison Labs POC
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft: Edison extension approach

Team —

Meghan at Edison just flagged that their integration will slip and they need runway. They asked for a 3-week extension to their time-boxed POC and a tighter guarantee on unit economics if we extend. Key constraints: procurement wants a simple amendment (no full contract redo), security needs SOC2 evidence before extension kicks in, and they prefer an extension that doesn't increase their long-term commitment.

What I want to propose (draft):
- 3-week extension to the POC (no change to per-token pricing) OR
- Convert 30% of the unused days into a $20k credit pool they can draw for overage/usages (usage-agnostic credits) if they sign a 6-month pilot by end of Q3.
- Extension conditioned on completion of enabled integration milestone (staging data ingestion) and receipt of SOC2 evidence packet.

Attachments to prepare for external: short SoW amendment, pricing matrix that shows the credit conversion math, SOC2 evidence summary.

Can you two take the pricing matrix and the conditional language? I can draft the external email.

Thanks,
Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Edison Labs POC — request for short extension

Hi Laura —

Quick note: integration hit a blocker with our data transform; team estimates ~2–3 weeks to finish. Procurement is ok with an amendment but needs clarity on cost impact. We'd prefer a solution that doesn't increase our committed spend — credits that don't expire quickly would work. Also procurement will need SOC2 evidence and an updated runbook before sign-off.

Can you send a short proposal by Friday? If it looks good, we'll route to procurement and the CTO for sign-off.

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Edison Labs POC — proposal attached

Hi Meghan —

Thanks for the quick heads-up — totally understand the slip. We've put together a short, conditional extension that should meet procurement's ask while keeping the commercial impact minimal. Key points in the attached packet: pricing-matrix-ED-2026.xlsx (shows both pure time extension and credit conversion), PoC-Statement-of-Work-ED-2026.pdf (one-page amendment language), SOC2-evidence-summary.zip (redacted evidence summary).

Highlights (proposal summary):
- Option A — Time extension: add 3 weeks to the POC; same per-token pricing; no change to billing cadence.
- Option B — Hybrid credits: convert up to 30% of remaining POC days into a $20k credit pool valid for 12 months. Credits apply to overages and dedicated-run tests; credits do not count toward committed spend unless Edison signs a 6-month pilot by 2026-09-30, at which point credits convert 1:1 against the first-month invoice.
- Conditional gating: extension effective once (1) SOC2 evidence summary received by procurement, (2) staging test completes (we'll require a brief signoff from your integration lead).

If procurement wants the simplest path, Option A gets you immediate runway with minimal paperwork. Option B gives Edison optionality and protects Redwood from an open-ended extension.

I've attached the three documents to this email for procurement and your CTO to review. Priyom/Karthik — can you confirm the credit validity window and conversion language? Also confirm we can honor the conversion if they move to a 6-month pilot.

Best —
Laura

Attachments: pricing-matrix-ED-2026.xlsx (excel), PoC-Statement-of-Work-ED-2026.pdf (pdf), SOC2-evidence-summary.zip (zip)
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Meghan O'Neill <meghan@edisonlabs.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Edison Labs POC — proposal attached

Meghan / Laura —

Quick calibration from pricing: Option B is fine with the $20k credit pool. A couple clarifications we added to the attached matrix:
- Credit pool valid for 12 months from date of extension activation (we can extend this to 18 months for enterprise procurement if Edison signs the pilot by 2026-09-30).
- Credits apply to overage token charges and throughput testing runs (non-refundable).
- If Edison signs the 6-month pilot by 2026-09-30, up to $10k of the credit pool can be applied to the first invoice; the remainder rolls as a post-commit credit.
- SOC2 evidence must be acknowledged by procurement within 5 business days for extension activation; otherwise extension will auto-expire and we'll revert to original end date.

I've also added a short alternative: a 2-week no-cost grace period followed by a pro-rated daily consumption charge if integration runs longer — it's less paperwork but gives Edison less optionality.

Happy to join a quick call with procurement to walk through the matrix.

Cheers,
Priyom
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
